verdict.rationale: Galileo is a SaaS evaluation and observability platform, so publishing a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The probe found no spec: every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. No doc in the pack mentions a downloadable API spec; llms.txt and the MCP server are machine-readable docs and tooling, not an API specification.
